summary: Lincoln County, WV lookout (US 156) registered 2008; observer's cabin announced 1959; ranger mentioned 1962; register says removed and state list says gone.

facts.status_note: Register says 'This tower has been removed.'; firelookout.org says 'Tower Gone'; no removal date given

events.note: Item dated May 24, 1959: Asher W. Kelly, assistant state forester in charge of forest fire control, said several minor construction projects would be completed before the fall fire season and that a new observer's cabin would be built at Buck Knob; completion not confirmed in the sources read
Item dated May 1, 1962 (as quoted on Forest Lookouts): a fire tower ranger at Buck Knob, Lincoln County, reported 3.21 inches of rain in a three-hour period
Registered September 16, 2008 as US 156, WV 6; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: administered by West Virginia Division of Forestry
register says the tower has been removed
firelookout.org marks the tower as gone

evidence.quote: A new observer's cabin will be built at Buck Knob, Lincoln County.

Asher W. Kelly, assistant state forester in charge of forest fire control

notes_for_editor: Two pages plus the state list were read, and one web search added nothing. No construction date and no removal date were found, so the story does not give either. The register credits a photo to Ronnie Scarbro, but no image URL appeared in the cached text, so no photo entry was made. The 1959 cabin is recorded as an announcement only.
